title: What’s New in Xacta 3.1.1: Faster Compliance Automation, Better Risk Visibility, and Centralized Remediation Management
summary: Xacta 3.1.1 streamlines compliance activities so users can spend more time evaluating risk and less time repeating administrative tasks.
body_markdown:
Security and compliance teams are being asked to move faster while managing more data, more systems, and more complex requirements.[Xacta](https://www.telos.com/offerings/xacta/) ® 3.1.1 helps teams meet that challenge with practical improvements across[Xacta 360](https://www.telos.com/offerings/xacta-360-continuous-compliance-assessment/) ™, Xacta Propagation Utility,[Xacta.io](https://www.telos.com/offerings/xacta-io-continuous-security-assessment/) ™,[Xacta.ai](https://www.telos.com/offerings/xacta-ai/) ™, and[Xacta Xchange](https://www.telos.com/offerings/xacta-xchange/) ™. This release makes it easier for teams to turn information into action, with less effort, better context, and stronger connections.


### **One Release, Five Customer Outcomes**


We’ve improved workflow, intelligence, remediation, and integration—but what matters most is how these changes help customers get their work done every day.


- **Work faster.** It’s now easier to carry over criteria, preserve inheritance decisions, search more efficiently, and complete routine tasks with fewer clicks.
- **Improve visibility.** Surface threats at every location, retain vulnerability filters, and use clearer visuals to spot risks.
- **Use richer intelligence.** Bring context and cross-regulation implementation guidance from Xacta.io into AI-assisted work.
- **Manage remediation.** Create, locate, update, and synchronize remediation plans in both Xacta.io and Xacta 360.
- **Connect more systems.** Use scoped APIs, ready-to-use integrations, identity import, and direct regulation transfer.


### **Workflows That Make Work Easier**


Xacta 3.1.1 streamlines common compliance activities so users can spend more time evaluating risk and less time repeating administrative steps. The Xacta Propagation Utility can copy criteria questions between compatible projects, preserving overlays, inherited controls, and manually locked applicability. It also retains manual inheritance adjustments during the propagation of inheritance questionnaire responses.


Teams can propagate a complete regulation — or a new version of a regulation — from one source project to multiple compatible destination projects. Missing content and references are added without overwriting existing project data, helping organizations introduce updated requirements more consistently at scale.


Within Xacta 360, users working in List View can move directly to the previous or next record while retaining their active search, filters, sort order, permissions, and page context. Overlay evaluation and propagation enhancements further reduce rework by preserving and applying the information teams have already established.


**New in 3.1.1** : Xacta 360 can optionally populate Root Cause and Mitigations and Countermeasures for test-generated risks using the Test Notes and Recommended Fix values from failed tests.


### **Richer Intelligence in the Moment**


Xacta.ai prompts can now use Xacta 360 and Xacta.io vocabularies together, bringing governance, asset, and vulnerability context into the same analysis. This broader source context gives users richer information and greater depth when evaluating security and compliance questions.


Xacta.ai’s capabilities have been expanded to draw on a wider range of information, delivering faster, more accurate answers grounded in your organization’s compliance context. Organizations can upload supported regulations — including industry, government, and organization-defined content — and provide implementation context, best practices, and suggested supporting artifacts for each control. Teams can then reference that guidance in AI prompts to produce more relevant, consistent implementation content.


### **A Clearer Path From Findings to Remediation**


Xacta.io expands centralized remediation management by helping teams organize findings, assign ownership, track progress, and preserve visibility as issues move toward resolution. Enhancements to Tenable data processing and vulnerability workflows improve the quality and usability of the information teams rely on for prioritization.


In Xacta 360, threats are associated with new non-testable locations so users can assess and modify threat weightings during setup; existing non-testable locations receive the appropriate threat associations during upgrade. Xacta MetriX also adds Area, Polar, and Heat Map charts, flexible chart coloring, and improved dashboard scaling to make trends and priorities easier to understand.


### **A Stronger Bridge Across the Security Ecosystem**


Xacta 3.1.1 gives administrators more control over API access through permissions assigned by endpoint and method. New artifact and software APIs, Microsoft Entra ID user import improvements, and a more seamless path for bringing Xacta 360 regulations into Xacta.io help teams integrate Xacta into existing processes.


Xacta Xchange expands the sources and destinations available for security data. The release supports integrations involving ServiceNow® CMDB, Prisma® Cloud, eMASS, Named Query, and runZero®, along with a direct way to download and update supported integration packages.


Customers can also ingest MITRE ATT&CK® Enterprise techniques through Xacta Xchange and use them in Xacta 360 as project-defined threats. Relating these techniques to realized risks in the Risk Matrix helps organizations identify security gaps and make more informed prevention, response, and recovery decisions.


### **The Information You Need — Where You Need It**


Across the suite, Xacta 3.1.1 includes focused improvements to search and filtering, interface responsiveness, logging, data presentation, and content handling. These refinements complement the release’s larger features and make everyday work more predictable for users and administrators.


Together, these updates help organizations automate routine compliance work, enrich risk decisions with connected data, and move more efficiently from insight to action.
